profile.summary: Soccer Without Borders is a nonprofit that uses soccer as a way to support the growth and success of underserved young people. It offers youth programs, coach training and community soccer programs. It is headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland, and also runs a Bay Area program in Oakland.
